hero.subheadline: A curated women-first evening for Bengaluru builders
hero.valueProposition: An in-person networking mixer during Bengaluru Tech Week connecting women founders, engineers, designers, product leaders, and researchers.

content.whyJoin:
The Women In Tech Mixer is a women-first evening built around structured introductions, small-group circles, and real conversations with Bengaluru's builder community - not another content-heavy event. You meet founders, engineers, designers, product leaders, researchers, students, operators, and community leaders who are building seriously across the city.

Spots are deliberately limited and curated so the room stays useful, safe, and high-signal. For women in tech who are tired of generic networking events, this is a focused way to make meaningful connections during Bengaluru Tech Week (1-6 September 2026).
content.whoShouldApply:
This mixer is for women builders across Bengaluru - founders, engineers, designers, product leaders, researchers, students, operators, and community leaders. If you are building in Bengaluru for India and the world and want a high-signal room to meet peers, this is for you.

Spots are limited and curated, with approvals sent closer to the event date, so a strong registration profile helps.
benefits: Connection with Bengaluru's founders, engineers, and product leaders
Part of the wider Bengaluru Tech Week ecosystem
tips: Register early, since spots are limited and curated
Fill out your registration details carefully to help hosts curate a useful room
Come ready with a one-line introduction of who you are and what you build
Follow the hosts if you have questions before the event

shouldYouApply.idealFor: This is ideal for a woman builder in Bengaluru who wants a curated, high-signal evening to meet peers across the city's tech ecosystem during Bengaluru Tech Week.
goodFit: A founder or operator building in Bengaluru
An engineer or designer looking to expand their network
A student or researcher in tech
A community leader or investor in the ecosystem
notIdealFor: People looking for a content-heavy conference
Anyone who cannot attend in person in Bengaluru on 2 September 2026

faq.question: When does the mixer take place?
faq.answer: On 2 September 2026, from 18:30 to 21:30, as part of Bengaluru Tech Week (1-6 September 2026).

faq.question: Where is it held?
faq.answer: In Bengaluru, India. The exact venue is shared through the event listing on Luma.

faq.question: Who can attend?
faq.answer: The evening is women-first and curated for women builders - founders, engineers, designers, product leaders, researchers, students, operators, and community leaders.

faq.question: Is there a fee?
faq.answer: Registration is free; spots are limited and approval-based.

submissionGuide.detail: Sign up through the Luma listing for the Women In Tech Mixer.
Approvals are sent closer to the event date after the hosts curate the room.
Join the structured introductions and small-group circles on the evening of 2 September.
